## ParExpOperator type

The upstream ParExpOperator domain: exact named tokens, the Go zero value, and explicitly validated unnamed uint32 values. Constants shared by upstream families retain their shared numeric identity.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ParExpOperator =
  | 0
  | typeof AlternateUnset
  | typeof AlternateUnsetOrNull
  | typeof ArrayExclude
  | typeof ArrayIntersect
  | typeof AssignUnset
  | typeof AssignUnsetOrNull

  | typeof ErrorUnset
  | typeof ErrorUnsetOrNull
  | typeof LowerAll
  | typeof LowerFirst
  | typeof MatchEmpty
  | typeof OtherParamOps
  | typeof RemLargePrefix
  | typeof RemLargeSuffix
  | typeof RemSmallPrefix
  | typeof RemSmallSuffix
  | typeof UpperAll
  | typeof UpperFirst
  | RawOperator<'ParExpOperator'>;
```
